Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Lines Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Flax
Colors: Linen
Made in the United States and imported The serged stitch lines and flaxen linen fabric make this casual throw pillow ideal for contemporary color schemes and sophiticated places, but versatile enough to pair with any décor. 17"L x 17"W Spot Clean.
